policy: Original and candidate at each identical scene clock, same frozen C161 and fixed matcher. 14 development RIRs disjoint from this fit; established exposed source data. Nominal full-cue wet RMS 9 dB above the local background. Only cue level changes; mic gain constant across rates and levels in a room/background cell. Source clock moves only the emitted wake audio while commands keep their own clock. PCM is a digital simulation, absolute SPL and physical device timing unmeasured.
